author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಜೀವಮಾನದ ನಡತೆ ಕಾದು ಫಲ ನೀಡಲಿವೆ
ನೋವುನಲಿವಿನ ಲೆಕ್ಕಕುತ್ತರವ ಪಡೆವೆ
ಸಾವುಬದುಕಿನ ನಡುವೆ ಬೇಕುಬೇಡಗಳಿಹವು
ಸಾವಕಾಶದಿ ನಡೆಯೊ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: A lifetime’s conduct waits, then gives its fruit;
you will get the answer to the account of pain and joy;
between death and life there are wants and don’t-wants;
walk on unhurried, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Our conduct over a lifetime bears fruit in time, and the ledger of joy and sorrow is settled. Between birth and death lie countless desires; move through them calmly.
